prompt: I'm about to start the UI design for our pet care marketplace app. Before I open Figma, help me gather design references -- I want to look at what other pet apps, marketplaces, and booking platforms are doing visually.

assertions.text: Guides user to specific reference platforms (Mobbin, Dribbble, competitors)
Organizes references by category (pet apps, marketplace patterns, booking flows)
Identifies common visual patterns relevant to pet care marketplace
Produces a structured design references deliverable or moodboard framework
Establishes visual vocabulary that prevents blank-canvas paralysis
